text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed.** Satellite data show about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss on the 58.1 ha asset in 2023, or 1.2% of its area. The 2020 forest reference agrees across the mapped loss area.

Of the loss area, 0.4 ha was mapped as planted eucalyptus forest and 0.3 ha was outside the 2021 mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting and does not by itself establish deforestation or a change in land use. The cause is unknown.
